solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Son with stomach upset was dizzy

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the word for stomach upside down, reading it from the bottom

parts.note: a maw is an animal's stomach or gullet

explanation.surface: A boy with an upset tummy feels giddy.
explanation.definitionFit: When your head swam you felt giddy, so the past tense of swim in this sense matches being dizzy.

clue.text: Member to finish as an extremely famous person?

parts.note: a leg is a limb, a member of the body
to end is to finish

explanation.surface: Does a limb that wraps things up count as a celebrity?
explanation.definitionFit: A legend is someone renowned, a figure of enormous fame and reputation.

clue.text: Greeting in a couple of lines ancient city got finally

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for line, so two lines give LL
Thebes was a city of ancient Greece and also of ancient Egypt

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word got

explanation.surface: A salutation tucked into a couple of lines of verse about an old city.
explanation.definitionFit: Wishing someone good fortune is a common farewell or message of goodwill, a greeting.

clue.text: Firm in Peru in trouble gets to recover

indicators.note: in tells us the firm's letters go inside the reworked country
in trouble suggests the letters of Peru are disturbed and rearranged

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A company in a Peruvian crisis manages to recover its losses.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue has two 'in's: the first puts the firm inside, and the second belongs to 'in trouble', which shuffles the country into REUP.
explanation.definitionFit: To recoup losses is to get back or regain what was spent, i.e. recover them.

clue.text: High-level plan sure to work out

indicators.note: to work out the plan sure letters means to rearrange them into a new order

explanation.surface: A strategic plan is certain to succeed.
explanation.definitionFit: Supernal means celestial or lofty, belonging to the heavens, hence high-level.

clue.text: See game with minimal runs scored

indicators.note: scored means crossed out, so that letter is struck from the word

parts.note: sport is a game
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs, given minimally as one letter

explanation.surface: Watch a cricket match where hardly any runs were made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scored' looks like cricket scoring but means scored through, deleted.
explanation.definitionFit: To spot something is to notice or catch sight of it, i.e. see it.

clue.text: One in B&B joined by university yobs wasting time as boozers

indicators.note: in means the numeral sits inside the pair of letters

parts.note: the letters B and B, from bed and breakfast
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: wasting means losing or throwing away that letter

parts.note: louts are yobs, rough uncouth youths

explanation.surface: Someone at a guesthouse is joined by student hooligans drinking away the hours.
explanation.definitionFit: Bibulous describes someone fond of drink, behaving like heavy drinkers.

clue.text: Aid to farmer — if sterile ground is to get right

indicators.note: ground is the past tense of grind, so the letters of if sterile are crushed and rearranged

explanation.surface: A farmer's helper: if the soil is barren, it should be put right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ground' reads as soil but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Manure or chemical feed spread on fields helps crops grow, so it aids a farmer.

clue.text: It sounds like you and I will change direction

indicators.note: It sounds like signals that the word is spoken and matched to a word of the same sound

parts.note: you and I will contracts to we'll

explanation.surface: A sentence about two people deciding to turn around.
explanation.definitionFit: To wheel is to turn or pivot, as soldiers wheel to face a new way.

clue.text: Supply required by French department to achieve balance

parts.note: to equip is to supply or furnish
the Oise is a department of northern France named after its river

explanation.surface: Provisions needed by a French region to keep things stable.
explanation.definitionFit: Equipoise is a state of equilibrium, an even balance of forces.

clue.text: Expert presenting some art in a new way

indicators.note: in a new way means the letters of some art are presented rearranged

explanation.surface: A specialist showing off a few pieces of art freshly arranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A maestro is a master of an art, a virtuoso or expert.

clue.text: Charge rent that's ridiculous on superior street

indicators.note: that's ridiculous suggests the word rent is made absurd, its letters jumbled

parts.note: U stands for upper-class, hence superior

explanation.surface: Billing an absurd rent on an upmarket road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charge' looks like billing but is the verb meaning to give someone a duty.
explanation.definitionFit: To charge someone with a task is to commit it to their care, a synonym.

clue.text: Fighting unit of the Engineers led by baddie

indicators.note: led by places the engineers after the villain, who goes in front

parts.note: a cad is a dishonourable man, a baddie
RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army

explanation.surface: A military group of sappers under the command of a villain.
explanation.definitionFit: A cadre is a core group of trained soldiers forming the framework of a unit.

clue.text: What could make PC be scary? Ultimately the whole virtual environment

indicators.note: could make suggests the letters of PC be scary can be rebuilt into something else
Ultimately points to the final letter of the word the

explanation.surface: Asking what could make a personal computer frightening.
explanation.definitionFit: Cyberspace is the notional realm of computer networks, the entire online virtual world.

clue.text: One offers drink with buffet at ball thrown on green

parts.note: to buffet is to strike, to punch
in the game of bowls, a bowl is the ball rolled on a lawn called the green

explanation.surface: A drink served at a buffet alongside a game of bowls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'buffet' suggests a spread of food but is the verb to strike. Bowls is a lawn game, popular in Britain, where balls are rolled on a green.
explanation.definitionFit: A large bowl from which a mixed drink is ladled out serves drinks to guests.

clue.text: Like varieties of churchmanship everywhere

definitions.meaning: Anglican worship is called high church or low church, so these are two styles
searching in every place, both up and down

explanation.definitionFit: High and Low Church name Anglican traditions, while searching high and low is an idiom for looking in every place.

clue.text: Scientists in bars, egoistic lot getting sozzled

indicators.note: getting sozzled means becoming drunk, so the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: Researchers in pubs, a self-centred crowd, getting very drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Researchers who study bacteria are a kind of scientist.

clue.text: Think about nothing, then stir to depose leader

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about
O is the round figure zero, nothing

indicators.note: to depose leader means removing the first letter of the word for stir

parts.note: to agitate is to stir or shake up

explanation.surface: Contemplating nothing, then rousing people to overthrow a ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: To cogitate is to ponder or reflect deeply, i.e. think hard.

clue.text: It is likely that Ray's idea wlll be seen as daft

indicators.note: seen as daft suggests the letters of Ray's idea are made silly, rearranged

explanation.surface: Ray probably has a foolish notion.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is used to concede that something is probably so, meaning it seems likely.

clue.text: Just having a part of hospital to one side

parts.note: right means just or fair
a ward is a room or section of a hospital

explanation.surface: A fair hospital having its own wing.
explanation.definitionFit: Rightward means towards the right, to one side.

clue.text: Doctor coming with coloured fluids — they are to be swallowed

parts.note: inks are coloured liquids for writing

explanation.surface: A physician arrives with coloured potions to be taken.
explanation.definitionFit: Beverages are liquids taken by mouth, so they are things to be swallowed.

clue.text: Venomous type, more insane, putting maiden off

indicators.note: off means that letter is taken away from the word

parts.note: madder means crazier, more insane
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A poisonous character, crazier still, alarming a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maiden' suggests a young woman, but it is cricket's maiden over, M.
explanation.definitionFit: The adder is Britain's only venomous snake, a viper.

clue.text: Country houses in south of Ireland Bill possesses

indicators.note: in a down clue the south of a word is its bottom, its final letter

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
has means possesses

explanation.surface: Rural homes in southern Ireland owned by a man called Bill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'south of Ireland' suggests Cork or Kerry, but it means the last letter of Ireland. A dacha is a Russian country house.
explanation.definitionFit: Dachas are Russian country villas or cottages, so country houses.

clue.text: Problem in road Rod found around front of the house

indicators.note: found around means the rod surrounds the other letters

parts.note: a pole is a rod

indicators.note: front of means the opening letter of the word the

explanation.surface: A man named Rod discovers a problem in front of his house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rod' looks like a name but is a pole.
explanation.definitionFit: A pothole is a hole in a road surface, a hazard for drivers.

clue.text: Animal getting over railway and crossroads?

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for over
X is the shape of a crossroads

explanation.surface: A creature crossing a rail line at a junction.
explanation.definitionFit: The oryx is a large African and Arabian antelope with long straight horns.

clue.text: Word meaning 'charges' in concise dictionaries

parts.note: dicts is a shortened form of dictionaries

explanation.surface: Looking up a word that means 'charges' in short dictionaries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link word but supplies IN. DICTS is a concise form of dictionaries.
explanation.definitionFit: To indict someone is to formally accuse or charge them with a crime.

clue.text: Observe daughter, one with potential to grow up?

definitions.text: one with potential to grow up?

parts.note: to see is to observe

explanation.surface: Watch your daughter, someone who will grow up.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition suggests a child, like the daughter; it is a seed that grows into a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A seed holds the potential to sprout and grow into a plant.

clue.text: Vessel getting lacerated they emptied when reaching island

parts.note: cut means lacerated

indicators.note: emptied removes the inner letters of they, leaving its outside pair

parts.note: Sark is one of the Channel Islands

explanation.surface: A ship cuts them up on arriving at an island.
explanation.walkthrough: The Cutty Sark is a famous tea clipper preserved at Greenwich in London.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous clipper is a sailing ship, a vessel.

clue.text: Indian offering love, a man of wisdom

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, O
a sage is a wise man

explanation.surface: A Native American giving love, a wise man.
explanation.definitionFit: The Osage are a Native American people of the Great Plains, historically called Indians.
